  3. Closed tenders below €140k

Closed tenders below €140k

For purchases with a value above €15,000 and equal to or below €140,000 EFSA uses the “negotiated procurement procedure” which involves inviting candidates of EFSA’s choice to submit an offer. Additionally, as EFSA wants to keep cooperation opportunities as open as possible, it is also possible for you to express an interest in being invited to these negotiated procedures. Just follow the simple procedure below.

Did this page meet your expectations ?
Thank you! Any more feedback?
Can you help us make it better for you — Why didn’t it meet your expectations?

We value your anonymous feedback and use it to continually improve your experience. Do not include any personal data in your feedback: if you require an individual response, visit our Contact us page.

Your feedback is processed using Netigate, an AI-assisted analysis tool. Through its embedded AI functionalities, Netigate supports the analysis of feedback and enables EFSA to identify insights and trends. These are used solely internally to improve the EFSA website service. All reports generated by Netigate are systematically reviewed and validated by the EFSA staff in charge at the Communication Unit before use.
